desc: Spin Dash (#51) ends into the run with the stick held, as Paper Mario's: from a run, L, and the stick held right through the spin's end, Mario runs on at the run's speed at once (no let-go of the stick first); from a walk with the gentler stick, he walks on alike (back west, clear of the meadow's enemies)
log_must: \[spin\] Mario's spin ends \((its end|a wall)\): \d+ units in \d+ frames, at \([^)]*\), then runs
\[spin\] Mario's spin ends \((its end|a wall)\): \d+ units in \d+ frames, at \([^)]*\), then walks
